limitations: N04 answers the case-file sheet with a staged file and saves exports into the fixture data root without a sheet; N10 drives the production rfd NSOpenPanel/NSSavePanel (the fixture switch fixture-native-sheets) with driver-owned temporary files. No Accessibility tree is saved while a panel lists folders.
The public example catalog is a local snapshot served at the fixture catalog URL; the production URL is raw.githubusercontent.com.
